purpose: Return compact public marker-panel support for allowed labels on requested parent clusters without assigning labels.

input.parent_cluster_ids: A nonempty array of unique parent identifiers in the current public context.

output.label_marker_support: One row per requested parent and its observed subclusters. Each row contains at most four labels with supported public marker evidence, positive-marker count, panel size, coverage, support status, and at most three matched markers.
output.unsupported_labels: Absent labels are not treated as negative evidence.

execution_boundary.interpreter: The common benchmark runner calls executePublicAction for every system.
execution_boundary.data_scope: Current public context and matching precomputed public marker store only.
